entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • dotnet completions script --help crashes #51890
  • dotnet.exe version 10 ignores the flag --self-contained false and builds the self-contained executable if the option p:PublishSingleFile=true is set #51888
  • CA2208 incorrectly issued for C# 14 extension members #51887
  • `dotnet tool exec` needs to support the `--tool-manifest` flag #51885
  • `dotnet run` should explicitly block the use of traversal projects #51880
  • `dotnet watch` support for Traversal projects (and solutions?) #51879
  • Poor experience for .NET tool installed by unsupported SDK #51878
  • Establish a pattern/helper for handling solutions and traversal projects in a similar way #51877
  • Traversal projects should have a template for easier creation #51876
  • Traversal projects should be supported in the base .NET SDK #51875
  • Support MSBuild Traversal SDK projects fully in the .NET CLI #51874
  • `dotnet test` does not ignore projects marked as `<IsTestProject>false</IsTestProject>` with Microsoft.Testing.Platform #51873
  • `dnx` ignores UNC working directory for native tools #51871

Closed

  • Don't DllImport System.Native libraries #26919
  • dotnet format does not work in dotnet 10 #51737
  • Test duration shouldn't be shown as 0 if no value was provided #51544
    10.0.2xx
  • Add tests for `dotnet test` (MTP) for response files #50631
  • Investigate feasibility of using cache-related ideas from RunCommand in dotnet test for MTP #50883
  • Build fails with missing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.dll #50419
  • Setting EnableDefaultCompileItems=True in a file-based app results in CS2002 as app file is included multiple times #51785
    10.0.2xx
  • Symbols validation fails for 4 sdk packages #12995

PullRequests

Created

  • Update MicrosoftBuildMinimumVersion to 17.11.48 #51892
  • Disable NuGetAudit for test assets #51891
  • Remove unused command resolver and parser files #51889
  • Add 'Eliminate Duplicate SDK Files' one-pager #51886
  • Cleanup test command #51883
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #51881
    Area-CodeFlow
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #51872
  • Mention deprecation of RoslynCompilerType=Framework in the docs #51870
    documentation, Area-NetSDK
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.2xx' => 'main' #51869

Merged

  • Fix template resolution ordering bug #51861
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.2
  • Remove StatInterop.cs - unused P/Invoke to private runtime library #51661
  • [release/10.0.2xx] [dotnet-cli] prompt for target framework using `Spectre.Console` #51859
  • Fix CS2002 when EnableDefaultCompileItems=true in file-based apps #51790
    Area-run-file
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.2xx' => 'main' #51851

Updated

  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 140: Build ID 2846870 #51419
  • Add telemetry logger support for API-based MSBuild usage with BannedApiAnalyzer protection #51068
  • [dotnet test][MTP] Avoid surfacing `MissingTestSessionEnd` when the exit code is already non-success #51857
  • Fix updating `globaljsonworkloadsets.json` #50372
    Area-Workloads
  • Fix slnf test assets to use `\\` #51791
  • Handle empty string returned from `Environment.GetFolderPath` #51854
    Area-run-file
  • Skip obj→bin copy on build failure in CSharpCompilerCommand #51614
    Area-run-file
  • Add trailing slash for -o Fixes #45682 #48640
    untriaged, Area-CLI, stale
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.2xx' #51858
  • [release/10.0.2xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #51847
  • Rename dnup to dotnetup #51808
